title: Crack Chicken Roll Ups
instructions: Mix chicken, cream cheese, sour cream, seasonings, bacon, and cheese together until combined.
In a separate bowl, mix the sauce ingredients (cream of chicken, milk, ranch dressing).
Spray a 9x13 dish and spread 1/3 of the sauce evenly on the bottom.
Split the filling between the 12 crescent rolls and roll them up.
Place stuffed crescent rolls into the casserole dish and spoon the rest of the sauce over the tops.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes uncovered, then cover lightly with foil and bake an additional 10-15 minutes.
Check that dough is done by lifting one roll from the center.
